plain_english: Ever fully awake, he sees himself by himself; for the seer settled in his own form, what else is left?
sanskrit_cite: sarvadā suprabuddhas san paśyaty ātmānam ātmanā / draṣṭuḥ svarūpasaṃsthasya kim anyad avaśiṣyate

plain_english: To be always fully awake is for the mind to waste away; from that wasting, yogis truly see.
sanskrit_cite: sadaiva suprabuddhatvam etāvan manasaḥ kṣayaḥ / tatkṣayād yogināṃ samyaksākṣātkāro bhavaty alam

plain_english: Turned back into self-awareness, with no twoness left — he is king among yogis, a sun against the dark of ignorance.
sanskrit_cite: paryāvṛttaḥ svasaṃvittau vartate yas tv abhedataḥ / sa samrāḍ yogayuktānām ajñānadhvāntabhāskaraḥ

plain_english: The moon pales before the joy of tasting your own nature; with the inner organ gone, what is there left for me to get?
sanskrit_cite: svarūpānubhavāhlādadaśātītendusaṃsthitiḥ / avāptavyaṃ kim astīha kṣīṇāntaḥkaraṇasya me

plain_english: Self-knowledge and rest, firm and bright, for whoever holds them; freed from the mind's whirl, aloneness comes soon.
sanskrit_cite: svaparijñaptiviśrāntī sudṛḍhe yasya susphuṭe / tasya vṛttivimuktasya bhavet kevalatācirāt

plain_english: For yogis grounded in themselves, whose single mind sweeps aside the traces of grasping and the grasped — fortune's release is easy.
sanskrit_cite: grāhyagrahaṇasaṃskāratiraskāraikacetasām / yogināṃ svātmaniṣṭhānāṃ mokṣalakṣmīr na durlabhā

plain_english: Rest in my own form I have won, my sorrows ended, the split of grasped and grasper broken — I stand firm, abiding as I am.
sanskrit_cite: labdhā svarūpaviśrāntir nirvṛttā kleśasantatiḥ / grāhyagrāhakatā bhagnā svarūpastho' smi saṃsthitaḥ

plain_english: Whether up and about or gathered inward, whoever wins that nondual, wakened taste of his own nature knows what is real.
sanskrit_cite: abhedabodhasaṃbodhasvarūpānubhavasthitim / vyutthitaḥ sanniruddho vā labhate yaḥ sa tattvavit

plain_english: For one whose self-standing never slips in any state — what can the squabbles of scripture-rangers do to him?
sanskrit_cite: yasya sarvāsv avasthāsu svasthitir naiva lupyate / tasya kiṃ nāma kurvanti śāstrabhramaṇavibhramāḥ

plain_english: His self freed from the delusion brewed of real and unreal notions — he lives on among people, fear gone, always a yogi.
sanskrit_cite: vigalitasadasadvikalpasadasadbhramajanitamohamuktātmā / jīvann api janamadhye vigatabhayaḥ sarvadā yogī
